Role Purpose
• We are seeking a talented and motivated Accountant to take on a new Accounting Manager role in our Finance Centre of Excellence (CoE) in Pune. This is a key role within the Finance function, responsible for setting up and delivering high-quality accounting and assurance activities to financial controllers and accountants in Europe and across EXA Infrastructure’s footprint.
• The role will build out a GL accounting team of 4+ and deliver a high quality of accounting and support to accountants and controllers across the EXA footprint. High-quality month-end closes and balance sheet reconciliations are key, this role will help maintain the accuracy and integrity of the Group’s financial reporting. The role will also seek to automate manual process and support the re-implementation of the Oracle ERP in 2026.
• This position offers an excellent opportunity to grow within a supportive and collaborative environment, where learning, professional development, and mentoring of junior staff are actively encouraged.

Main Responsibilities
• Establish, lead, and develop a General Ledger (GL) accounting team of 4+ within the Finance Centre of Excellence (CoE) in Pune
• Deliver high-quality accounting services and assurance support to financial controllers and accounting teams across EXA Infrastructure’s European and global footprint.
• Own and oversee accurate and timely month-end close processes, ensuring adherence to group timetables and quality standards.
• Ensure completion and review of robust balance sheet reconciliations, maintaining strong controls and audit-ready documentation.
• Safeguard the accuracy, completeness, and integrity of the Group’s financial records and reporting.
• Act as a key point of contact for accounting queries, providing technical guidance and support to internal stakeholders.
• Drive standardisation, automation, and continuous improvement of accounting processes, reducing manual effort and operational risk.
• Support and contribute to the re-implementation of the Oracle ERP system ongoing for 2026.
• Partner closely with Finance, Tax, Treasury, and Audit teams to ensure alignment and effective financial control.
• Support internal and external audit processes, ensuring timely resolution of findings and implementation of improvements.
• Develop and maintain accounting policies, procedures, and documentation in line with Group standards.
• Coach, mentor, and develop team members, promoting a culture of learning, accountability, and high performance.
• Prepare the reconciliation of management reporting v/s IFRS results for cost of sales and SG&A

Individual Profile
• Qualified and experienced Chartered accountant with strong technical accounting knowledge and minimum 6 years of experience
• Proven ability to build, lead, and develop high-performing General Ledger (GL) accounting teams.
• Hands-on approach to delivering high-quality accounting outputs, including month-end close and balance sheet reconciliations.
• Strong attention to detail with a robust financial control and assurance mindset
• Experience working within a Finance Centre of Excellence (CoE) or shared services environment.
• Ability to partner effectively with financial controllers and accountants across multiple geographies.
• Comfortable operating in a complex, international organisation with European and global stakeholders
• Demonstrated commitment to maintaining the accuracy and integrity of group financial reporting.
• Proactive in identifying opportunities to automate, standardise, and improve manual accounting processes.
• Experience with ERP systems, ideally Oracle, and exposure to system implementations or re-implementations
• Strong leadership and people management skills, with a passion for mentoring and developing junior team members.
• Collaborative, adaptable, and motivated to grow within a supportive, learning-focused environment.

Our working environment

We are committed to working in the location where we do our best work. As a small and growing company with great offices in great locations, most employees will aim to be in the office 3 days a week and 2 days working from home/ other locations.

Here at EXA, we believe the future includes everyone, we are open to all applications to create an environment and culture that includes one and all. We are a proud global community that wants to drive diversity of thought though our employees and culture. We want you to come as you and make yourself and EXA successful.

CFO | Director – Finance & Accounts

Location: Pune

Experience: 15–20 Years

Qualification: Chartered Accountant (CA) | CS will be an added advantage

Budget: Up to ₹50 LPA, including approx. 10% variable linked to profitability and business objectives

Role Overview

We are looking for a dynamic, hands-on and commercially driven Finance leader to lead the Finance & Accounts function of a rapidly growing international organization with trading and manufacturing exposure.

This is not a conventional accounting-focused Finance role. The position will work closely with the Managing Director and international leadership teams and will be expected to play an active role in business growth, profitability, governance, working-capital improvement and organizational transformation.

The ideal candidate should combine strong financial controllership with commercial acumen, execution orientation and people leadership. The individual should be comfortable both with strategic discussions and getting personally involved when execution requires it.

Experience working with international stakeholders, particularly within European/German business environments, would be advantageous.

Key Responsibilities

Finance Leadership & Business Partnership
• Lead the complete Finance & Accounts function covering P&L, Balance Sheet, cash flow, MIS, statutory reporting and monthly/year-end closures.
• Act as a strategic Finance partner to the Managing Director and Leadership Team, providing financial insight for key business decisions.
• Translate financial information into clear business actions, rather than limiting Finance to reporting historical performance.
• Provide proactive analysis of sales, gross margin, pricing, customer/product profitability, operating expenses and EBIT development.
• Challenge business assumptions constructively and support management in identifying opportunities and risks early.

Business Planning, Profitability & Growth
• Lead annual Budget, Forecast and Mid-Term Planning processes in coordination with local and international stakeholders.
• Drive initiatives for profitability improvement, cost optimization and productivity enhancement.
• Develop strong visibility on profitability by customer, product/category, business segment and channel.
• Establish forward-looking financial indicators and early-warning mechanisms for management.
• Support business cases for investments, localization, sourcing, expansion and other strategic initiatives.

Working Capital & Cash Management
• Take ownership of cash flow, receivables, inventory and overall working-capital performance.
• Partner actively with Sales and Supply Chain to improve collections, DSO, inventory turns and cash conversion.
• Establish strong credit-control and customer-risk governance while balancing commercial requirements.
• Drive disciplined forecasting of liquidity and cash requirements.

Governance, Controls & Risk Management
• Strengthen the organization's Internal Financial Control framework, segregation of duties, approval authorities and maker-checker principles.
• Ensure robust processes covering customer/vendor master data, payments, procurement, credit management, inventory and financial postings.
• Drive implementation and continuous improvement of Delegation of Authority, SOPs and financial policies.
• Identify financial and operational risks proactively and ensure timely corrective actions.
• Ensure audit observations are translated into sustainable process improvements, rather than only audit closures.

Audit, Compliance & Statutory Responsibilities
• Lead and coordinate statutory, tax, internal, external and Group audits.
• Act as the key Finance interface with auditors and ensure professional, timely and well-supported closure of observations.
• Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards, taxation, corporate and statutory requirements.
• Maintain high standards of documentation, governance and audit readiness throughout the year.

Process & Digital Transformation
• Build scalable Finance processes suitable for a high-growth organization.
• Reduce dependence on manual/Excel-based processes through better utilization of ERP/SAP, automation and digital reporting tools.
• Strengthen management dashboards and decision-support reporting.
• Continuously identify opportunities to improve speed, accuracy, transparency and control across Finance processes.

International Stakeholder Management
• Coordinate closely with international Finance and Group functions, particularly stakeholders in Europe and Asia.
• Ensure timely and accurate Group reporting and alignment with international accounting/control requirements.
• Represent India Finance confidently in regional and global discussions.
• Build strong working relationships across cultures and functions.

Team Leadership & Organization Development
• Lead, coach and develop a Finance team of approximately 4-5 members, including CS, Finance Controller/Manager and Accounts team members.
• Build a culture of ownership, responsiveness, accountability and timely execution.
• Develop team capabilities and appropriate succession/backup structures.
• Set clear expectations and ensure commitments and deadlines are followed without requiring repeated escalation.
• Create an environment where Finance is viewed by other functions as a solution-oriented business partner.

Desired Profile
• Chartered Accountant with 15–20 years of progressive Finance & Accounts leadership experience.
• Strong experience within trading, distribution and/or manufacturing businesses.
• Previous exposure to an MNC or internationally managed organization strongly preferred.
• Experience working with European/German organizations or stakeholders would be advantageous.
• Strong understanding of accounting, taxation, treasury, compliance, audit, internal controls and financial governance.
• Strong exposure to working-capital management, commercial finance, budgeting and profitability management.
• Good ERP/SAP orientation and ability to drive process digitalization.
• Demonstrated experience in building/improving processes, rather than simply maintaining established systems.
• Proven ability to lead, motivate and develop Finance teams.
• Strong communication and stakeholder-management capability, including interaction with senior international management.

Leadership Attributes

We are particularly interested in candidates who are:

Hands-on | Energetic | Commercially minded | Accountable | Decisive | Analytical | Collaborative | Execution-driven | Comfortable with change

The successful candidate should demonstrate a strong sense of ownership and urgency, with the ability to move comfortably between strategic topics and operational execution.

Why This Opportunity?

This position offers substantially more than responsibility for Finance & Accounting.

The successful candidate will have the opportunity to:
• become a key member of the India Leadership Team;
• work directly with the Managing Director and international senior management;
• influence the financial and strategic direction of a high-growth business;
• build and transform Finance processes rather than simply inherit and maintain them;
• gain significant exposure to international stakeholders across Europe and Asia;
• contribute directly to growth, profitability, localization and organizational transformation initiatives;
• and develop the Finance function into a stronger business-partnering organization.

For an ambitious Finance professional, the position offers significant visibility, responsibility and scope to create measurable impact.

We are seeking a highly analytical and intellectually curious professional to support strategic decision-making through deep financial, company, industry, and competitive analysis. The role requires the ability to transform complex datasets and market intelligence into actionable insights for senior leadership.

The ideal candidate should demonstrate strong financial acumen, structured problem-solving, excellent presentation skills, and the ability to independently drive research projects with minimal supervision.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Analysis & Business Performance
• Analyze financial statements and business performance metrics, including EBITDA, working capital, return ratios, efficiency ratios, margins, and valuations.
• Build revenue-to-margin bridges and identify key drivers impacting profitability.
• Reconcile financial variances and prepare management-level analytical reports.
• Develop financial models and scenario analyses to support business decisions.

Company & Industry Research
• Conduct in-depth research on companies, industries, and market ecosystems.
• Evaluate business models, competitive positioning, technological capabilities, regulatory environments, and growth opportunities.
• Assess industry attractiveness, market structure, pricing power, and profitability implications.
• Analyze operational metrics and connect them to financial performance.

Competitive Intelligence & Benchmarking
• Develop comprehensive competitor benchmarking studies.
• Compare peer companies across financial, operational, commercial, and strategic dimensions.
• Normalize datasets for accounting policies, reporting periods, currency impacts, and business models.
• Present actionable insights for strategic decision-making.

Strategic Analytics & Insights
• Integrate and reconcile large, fragmented datasets from multiple sources.
• Identify trends, opportunities, risks, and business implications through data-driven analysis.
• Support market sizing, market share estimation, demand-supply analysis, and industry structure assessments.
• Provide recommendations backed by robust analytical frameworks.

Presentation & Executive Communication
• Create high-quality executive presentations and strategy decks.
• Develop compelling storylines, key messages, and insightful visualizations.
• Translate complex analysis into clear and concise recommendations for senior management.
• Coach and guide team members on presentation quality and analytical output standards.

Research Quality & Methodology
• Critically evaluate market research sources and methodologies.
• Identify limitations, assumptions, and risks within research findings.
• Ensure analytical conclusions are appropriately supported by data and evidence.
• Establish sound research frameworks for strategic projects.

Dashboarding & Reporting (Preferred)
• Design and structure multidimensional dashboards for management decision-making.
• Collaborate with stakeholders to define KPIs and reporting requirements.

• CA with 3-4 years of experience OR
• MBA (Finance) with 8-10 years of relevant experience in corporate strategy, industry research, equity research, investment research, ratings agencies, GCCs, consulting firms, or chemical/agri-business organizations.
